specialty_mod.settings_lead: Choose which specialty records your clinic uses and edit the antenatal schedule.
specialty_mod.modules_help: By default, records follow your clinic's specialty ({specialty}). Tick the ones your team uses; they appear on patient and visit pages only when they apply to the patient.

module_desc.dental: Tooth chart (FDI numbering), history of findings and a treatment plan.
module_desc.growth: Weight, length/height and head circumference of children, compared with the WHO Child Growth Standards.
module_desc.pregnancy: Pregnancy dating and due date, antenatal visits, a schedule of checks and the outcome.

specialty_mod.schedule_help: This is a general guide based on common antenatal-care recommendations — adjust it to your clinic's protocol. Weeks are completed weeks of pregnancy. Leave a name empty to keep the built-in wording.
specialty_mod.from_visit: Recording from the visit of {date} with {doctor}. Entries will be linked to this visit.

dental.title: Dental chart
dental.remove_confirm: The entry will no longer count on the chart. It stays in the history, marked as removed.
dental.tap_hint: Tap a tooth (or one of its surfaces) to record a finding.
dental.view_hint: Tap a tooth to see its history.
dental.procedure_help: Leave empty to use the service name.
dental.service_help: Picks the price from your services list.
dental.whole_mouth: Whole mouth / not a single tooth

child_growth.title: Growth
child_growth.head: Head circumference
child_growth.position_help: Lying down (length) is standard under 2 years, standing (height) from 2 years.
child_growth.empty_text: Record weight, length/height and head circumference to follow this child's growth.
child_growth.no_values: No values for this chart yet.
child_growth.from_visits: Measured at visits, not in the growth log yet
child_growth.prefilled: Filled in from this visit's vital signs — check before saving.
child_growth.need_profile_title: Date of birth and sex are needed
child_growth.need_profile: Percentiles and charts need the child's date of birth and sex in the patient profile. Measurements are still saved.
child_growth.beyond_who: The WHO Child Growth Standards used here cover 0–5 years. Measurements after 5 years are listed and plotted without reference curves or percentiles.
child_growth.pct_note: P = percentile against the WHO Child Growth Standards (hover for the z-score). Values below P2.3 or above P97.7 (beyond ±2 SD) are highlighted.
child_growth.who_note: Reference: WHO Child Growth Standards (2006), official LMS tables for 0–5 years, World Health Organization. Percentiles are computed with the LMS method; length before 2 years and height from 2 years follow the WHO convention (±0.7 cm).

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy
pregnancy.empty_text: Start a follow-up with the last menstrual period or a dating scan to get the due date and the schedule of checks.
pregnancy.not_eligible: Pregnancy follow-up is available for female patients. Set the patient's sex in the profile if it is missing.
pregnancy.lmp: First day of last menstrual period (LMP)
pregnancy.gravida_help: Number of pregnancies including this one.
pregnancy.ga_auto: Gestational age is calculated from the due date
pregnancy.prefilled: Weight and blood pressure are filled in from this visit's vital signs — check before saving.
pregnancy.schedule_note: A general guide based on common antenatal-care recommendations. Your clinic can edit it in the settings; follow your own clinical judgement.
pregnancy.schedule_custom_note: Your clinic's schedule (a guide edited by the clinic); follow your own clinical judgement.

schedule_items.booking_bloods: Booking visit and bloods (blood count, group and antibodies, infections screen)
schedule_items.dating_scan: Dating scan (and first-trimester screening if offered)
schedule_items.post_dates: Review if pregnancy continues past the due date

pregnancy.reopen_confirm: Reopen this pregnancy and clear its recorded outcome?

errors_specialty.NOT_FEMALE: Pregnancy follow-up is for female patients.
errors_specialty.PREGNANCY_OPEN: This patient already has an ongoing pregnancy. Record its outcome first.

spforms.title: Specialty records
spforms.removed: Record removed from the patient file (it stays in the audit trail).
spforms.none_on_help: Choose the records your clinic uses in the settings, or set each doctor’s specialty so their specialty’s records appear automatically.
spforms.remove_confirm: Remove this record from the patient file? It stays in the audit trail with the reason.
spforms.settings_sub: Structured clinical forms with scientific scores and classifications. They switch on by themselves from the clinic’s and each doctor’s specialty; turn any of them on or off.
spforms.set_doctor_specialty: Set each doctor’s specialty on the Doctors page so their specialty’s records appear automatically:
